summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its existing guaranty agreement with Goldman Sachs Bank USA. The amendment extends the period during which the company must maintain a lower cash liquidity covenant to eleven months following January 30, 2026, under a Master Repurchase Agreement dated January 30, 2026, involving RCRED Craftsman Administrator, LLC. This is a routine modification of financial obligations and does not represent a transformative corporate event or special situation. No pricing, premium, or transaction terms were disclosed. No board recommendation or advisors were named. Watch for future liquidity or covenant compliance updates.
